$ /bin/bash -c node <<'JS'

fs.writeFileSync('README.md',`# MCPJam arithmetic validation\n\nInstalled from npm in a clean Node.js environment. Dependencies ar

e pinned by package-lock.json.

## Reproduce

Keep MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY set to this isolated account.

\`\`\`sh

npm ci
npm run eval
\`\`\`

The script validates the versioned suite against project_fixture, runs it to completion, and wri
tes artifacts/eval-report.json. A completed passing run exits 0; a measured evaluation failure exits 1. Each invocation starts a n
ew run. If a launch response is lost, use its recorded idempotency key from artifacts/run.stderr to retry that launch rather than

starting another.

## Evidence

- artifacts/doctor.json: Streamable HTTP connection ready; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0 exposes ad
d with numeric a and b.\n- artifacts/add.json: direct call add(2,3) returned structuredContent.sum = 5 and isError = false.\n- .mc
pjam/evals/arithmetic.json: direct tool call followed by toolResultContains requiring the full text fragment {"sum": 5}. This is a
text-content assertion, not structural equality.\n- artifacts/eval-report.json: latest completed passing run, ${run.runs[0].id}.\
n- artifacts/negative-report.json: wrong-answer control requiring {"sum": 999} failed, with CLI exit 1.\n- artifacts/iterations.js
on: initial run's recorded tool arguments and result.\n\nThe isolated service labels these runs SIMULATED: deterministic fixture e
xecution; no hosted model or live billing. This checks the authored tool case and assertion path; it does not establish LLM tool-s

election accuracy or full MCP protocol conformance.

## Setup concerns resolved

Cloud servers are listed through mcpjam cloud
projects servers, rather than cloud servers. Schema version 2 requires mode agentWorkflow and a model field even for this direct
tool case. The platform refused toolResultMatchesSchema as outside its supported subset; toolResultContains succeeded. The local r
unner documentation says direct toolCall steps and gating tool-result assertions require the hosted runner, so this workflow uses

cloud eval run.

## Public documentation

- https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview
- https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals
-

https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference
- https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case

Downloaded public
documentation snapshots are in docs/ and docs-index.txt. No credentials are stored in these artifacts.\n`);
